exposure: high-risk perinatal HIV transmission (mothers without ART or viral suppression)
low-risk perinatal HIV transmission (mothers on ART with viral suppression)
outcome: uptake of perinatal HIV preventive interventions
cohort: 551 HIV-exposed infants (HEIs) and 542 mothers living with HIV managed at a subspecialty pediatric HIV program in Washington, DC, during 2013-2017
finding: In an area of high HIV prevalence in the US, a large proportion of low-risk HEIs received intrapartum ZDV and were delivered via CD, but missed opportunities for the prevention of perinatal HIV transmission were also observed.
mod_finding: A large proportion of low-risk HIV-exposed infants were delivered via cesarean delivery.
